postReview.title: Kairat Almaty 1-4 Club Brugge: Routine win keeps Champions League knockout hopes alive
postReview.description: Hans Vanaken and Mamadou Diakhon starred for Club Brugge as they secured a much-needed 4-1 win over Kairat Almaty in the Champions League.
